title: balsamorhiza incana var. tomentosa
intro: Balsamorhiza incana var. tomentosa, commonly known as Woolly Balsamroot or Woolly Balsam, is a plant species that belongs to the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Balsamorhiza incana var. tomentosa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
